name: Brand AI-Readiness Audit
description: An agentic marketplace of skills to audit a website for AI discoverability and engagement readiness.

skills.name: Audit Orchestrator
skills.description: The entrypoint skill that coordinates the AI readiness audit and generates a prioritized report.

skills.name: Discoverability Audit
skills.description: Analyzes the DOM for AI crawlability blockers (robots.txt, missing semantic HTML, JSON-LD, etc).

skills.name: Engagement Audit
skills.description: Analyzes the site layout for semantic orientation (nav, headers, main) and internal linking.

skills.name: AI Answerability Audit
skills.description: An agentic self-test that verifies if an LLM can accurately extract facts about the brand via live search grounding.
